title: Agent Office — asset manifest
description: Declares every image of the illustrated office (rooms, furniture, characters, accessories, themes) with its grid geometry and anchors. Paths are relative to design/ (later: to the app's asset root).

version.description: 2 = accessory contract v2 (back/front layers, landmarks), gear-free variants with defaultAccessories, seated (Batch 6) poses and station.seated. Renderers still read v1 fields (single-layer images) as a fallback.

tileWidth.description: CSS px of one tile at zoom 1 (96).

wallHeight.description: CSS px of the back walls (144).

anchor.description: Pixel of the floor's back corner (grid 0,0) in the shell image.

entrance.description: Floor tile where occupants enter and leave (front cutaway edge).

size.description: Image canvas in image px (from design/assets/anchors.json); lets the renderer lay out before the image loads.

category.description: Editor palette grouping (French keys shown as labels).

footprint.description: Required for floor and decal items.

orientations.description: Painted facings available. Rotating swaps footprint w/d and uses the other image (never a mirror).

images.description: Extra images keyed "<orientation>" or "<orientation>@<suffix>" (e.g. "se", "sw@night", "sw@on"); see themes[].furnitureVariants for lookup order.

anchor.description: Pixel of the footprint's back corner (floor/decal) or the bottom-left wall point (wall).

layerBias.description: Added to depth; use sparingly (e.g. +0.1 for a lamp that must sit over a sofa arm).

station.description: Present when the item is a place an agent can occupy (desk, sofa, shelf, server rack, coffee machine, meeting table).

seat.description: Fractional grid point (relative to the item origin) where the character's feet anchor goes.

facing.description: Facing of the standing (v1) occupant. Seated facing lives in station.seated.facing.

stack.description: Draw order of the composite, back to front. Tokens are part names, the item id (the item image itself) and "character" (the seated occupant).

parts.description: Composite parts drawn with the item, keyed by the names used in stack. A string is an image on the item canvas and anchor; an object can carry its own anchor, a grid offset (at, relative to the item origin) and variants (e.g. monitor on).

size.description: Image canvas in image px (from design/assets/anchors.json); lets the renderer lay out before the image loads.

mirror.description: Placeholder only: mirror the image (a stand-in until the dedicated art exists).

seatAnchor.description: Seat contact on this part (image px), e.g. chair@ne.

offsetByCharacter.description: Image-px offset of this part per occupant character id (keyboard within the smaller agents’ reach).

screen.description: Pixel of the monitor screen centre in the item image (image px), for the state glow.

blocks.description: Extra non-walkable tiles relative to the item origin (e.g. the chair tile in front of a desk). Not part of the footprint for overlap checks.

seated.description: Batch 6 seated composition, used when the occupant look has the seated poses (desk: seated-ne + seated-turn-sw; lounge: sofa-sit-sw). Otherwise the standing seat/stack/parts above apply. NE is a pose family selected inside the station, not a station orientation.

seat.description: Grid point (relative to the item origin) where the seated pose anchor lands.

stack.description: Draw order of the composite, back to front. Tokens are part names, the item id (the item image itself) and "character" (the seated occupant).

parts.description: Composite parts drawn with the item, keyed by the names used in stack. A string is an image on the item canvas and anchor; an object can carry its own anchor, a grid offset (at, relative to the item origin) and variants (e.g. monitor on).

size.description: Image canvas in image px (from design/assets/anchors.json); lets the renderer lay out before the image loads.

mirror.description: Placeholder only: mirror the image (a stand-in until the dedicated art exists).

seatAnchor.description: Seat contact on this part (image px), e.g. chair@ne.

offsetByCharacter.description: Image-px offset of this part per occupant character id (keyboard within the smaller agents’ reach).

clip.description: Visible polygon in canvas percentages, for the front armrest layer.

seatFrom.description: Place seated poses on the seatAnchor of parts.chair.

seatPoint.description: Seat contact on the item image itself (image px), e.g. the sofa’s first seat.

scaleByCharacter.description: Pose scale about the hip contact; body and accessory layers scale together.

stack.description: Draw order of the composite, back to front. Tokens are part names, the item id (the item image itself) and "character" (the seated occupant).

scaleByCharacter.description: Pose scale about the hip contact; body and accessory layers scale together.

turned.description: Chair contact and layers when a desk occupant turns toward the viewer.

seats.description: Standing spots for an interaction (meeting delegation scene), relative to the item origin. Facing picks the pose family (se/sw).

side.description: The wall plane the art is painted for.

pending.description: Not delivered yet (artist batch in progress). Documentation only: the renderer ignores this field and falls back as described in README §7.

size.description: Image canvas in image px (from design/assets/anchors.json); lets the renderer lay out before the image loads.

role.description: main = the primary agent's base character; subagent = the sibling family.

family.description: Characters sharing a family share silhouette and accessory fit.

canvas.description: Pose image size in image px (192×288 at 2× for the main character).

anchor.description: Feet centre in the pose canvas; identical for all poses and accessories.

variants.description: Colour variants. 'swatch' is shown in the editor; poses override the base images.

landmarks.description: Overrides the character landmarks for this variant.

defaultAccessories.description: Gear worn when a layout rule omits accessories. Precedence: rule.accessories if present (an explicit [] means none) → variant.defaultAccessories → []. Resolved once, server-side, into OfficeVM look.accessories; renderers never add defaults.

gearFree.description: The variant sprites carry no accessories; defaultAccessories are drawn as layers. false = legacy geared sprites (defaults must then be empty).

tintMask.description: Optional greyscale masks for runtime recolouring (later).

scaleBaked.description: True when scale is already painted into the pose pixels (sub-agents): render the canvas at scale 1.

head.description: Image-px y of the top of the head in the idle pose; markers and nameplates sit above it.

pending.description: Not delivered yet (artist batch in progress). Documentation only: the renderer ignores this field and falls back as described in README §7.

slot.description: One accessory per slot; draw order body → neck → face → head → badge.

images.description: v1 single-layer overlays per character id → pose. Fallback only: used for a pose that has no v2 layers.

pending.description: Not delivered yet (artist batch in progress). Documentation only: the renderer ignores this field and falls back as described in README §7.

layers.description: Accessory contract v2: per "<character>" or "<character>/<variant>" → pose → {back, front}. Render order: back layers → character → front layers, each in slot order. The variant key wins over the character key.

legacy.description: images are the deprecated v1 single-layer overlays (runtime:false in anchors.json): renderers may draw them only as a fallback where no v2 layers exist, and may hide them.

base.description: Optional: a season normally layers on whatever day/night theme is resolved (layout.theme.season).

extras.description: Season decor props drawn on top of the layout (never collide, never move furniture). Floor: {asset, x, y}; wall: {asset, wall, offset}.

room.description: Key in rooms[].images for this theme (defaults to the theme id, then the base theme).

furnitureVariants.description: Variant suffixes tried in order. The image key is built as "<orientation>@<suffix>" (e.g. "sw@night", "sw@on"), then "<orientation>", then furniture.image.

monitors.description: state = monitors light up only for active agent states; on = every occupied monitor is on (night), except offline.

pending.description: Not delivered yet (artist batch in progress). Documentation only: the renderer ignores this field and falls back as described in README §7.

accessoriesV2.description: Batch 5b coverage computed by build-manifest.mjs (look × delivered pose × accessory). complete = renderers hide the deprecated v1 overlays by default.

poseSet.description: Image per pose. The 8 SW poses are required; walking-se and the Batch 6 poses are optional. Back to the camera (NE): seated-ne (idle), working-ne (frame loop), reading-ne, thinking-ne, sleeping-ne, walking-ne, walking-nw. Facing the camera while seated: seated-turn-sw (+ wave/talking/celebrating/alert variants), seated-swivel (optional 3/4 in-between). Sofa: sofa-sit-sw, sofa-sleep-sw. Missing optional poses fall back (public/v2/office/assets.js POSE_FALLBACK).

landmarks.description: Head landmarks of one pose image (accessory contract v2), image px on the pose canvas. Normalised from anchors.json by build-manifest.mjs (public/v2/office/landmarks.js).

back.description: Drawn behind the character (far cup/band, back of a scarf, glasses arms).

frames.description: Per-frame layers for frame poses (working-ne): frame i swaps with body frame i. back/front above = frame 1.

oneOf.description: A pose with its own geometry or a frame loop. Exactly one of image/frames.

anchor.description: Seat anchor: overrides the character anchor for this pose (image px).

seatAnchor.description: Seated hip contact (image px). When the station has a seat point, the pose is placed so this pixel lands on it (stationRegistration seatFormula: characterTopLeft = seatTopLeft + seat.seatAnchor − pose.seatAnchor).

handAnchor.description: The hand contact for an interaction prop, in authored pixels.
